commit.summary: bind reviews to trusted verification gates

functionality.rationale: Incorrect payload or gate resolution could block valid tasks or allow unreviewed changes to integrate.

security.rationale: Task-controlled commands and post-review payload changes are integrity boundary bypasses.

performance.rationale: The added comparisons and registry lookup run only during task lifecycle operations.

compatibility.rationale: Accepted schema v1 and v2 records must retain their registered verification commands.

concurrency.rationale: Git refs and worktrees remain protected by the existing sequential lifecycle operations.

platform.rationale: Gate resolution and patch comparison must behave consistently in Bash and Python on CI hosts.

persistence.rationale: The task preserves record schema and stores no new durable lifecycle field.

adr.rationale: This closes bypasses in already accepted review and verification policies.

architecture.rationale: The documents identify the integration-owned gate registry and immutable reviewed payload.

roadmap.rationale: The task hardens delivery governance without changing product milestones.
